verdict.rationale: Vercel's own docs describe rolling production back to a previous deployment without a rebuild, and webhooks emit a 'Deployment Rollback' event. Rolling releases also support rolling back a partially promoted deployment. However, the evidence never shows that rollback is a one-click action or that any arbitrary past version can be the target. Missing for 10: evidence of one-click rollback UX, confirmation that any previous deployment (not just the last) can be restored, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll back a deployed service to any previous version in one click

citations.quote: Roll back to a previous deployment for swift recovery from production incidents.
Revert production to a previous deployment without a rebuild when something breaks.
Send a new deployment to a percentage of traffic first, then promote it or roll back.
